channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Danny Granger | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Danny Granger from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Lon Babby on Danny Granger
item.description:
Suns President of Basketball Operations Lon Babby said.

“If he (Granger) is capable of playing and providing that, that'd be a plus. He's a very professional person and very intelligent. We enjoy having him here. It just depends on how he feels. He thinks he's got more left. We hope he's right. He's going to work hard, I know that.”

Lon Babby on Danny Granger, Apr 19, 2015. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Danny Granger
item.description:
Scott Agness:Frank Vogel on Danny Granger:

“He's playing well. I'm happy to see he's finally getting healthy and having confidence in his knee.”

Frank Vogel on Danny Granger, Dec 31, 2014. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Derek Ochiai on Danny Granger
item.description:
HOOPSWORLD spoke with Dr. Derek Ochiai, a leading Surgeon and Sports Medicine expert based in Arlington, VA, on what to expect from Granger once he returns to action from his latest procedure.

“I would not say this constitutes the end of the line for Danny Granger.”

Derek Ochiai on Danny Granger, Sep 24, 2013. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Larry Bird on Danny Granger
item.description:
Scott Agness:Larry Bird on @Danny Granger:

“I expect a lot from Danny. Danny looks pretty good to me.”

Larry Bird on Danny Granger, Sep 23, 2013. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Chris Copeland on Danny Granger
item.description:
Scott Agness:Copeland on Granger:

“He’s back on the floor as well. He’s not 100%, but he’s looking great.”

Chris Copeland on Danny Granger, Sep 5, 2013. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Danny Granger
item.description:
Frank Vogel on Granger:

“It’s really exciting. Danny is on schedule, looks really good, he’s making progress each week and we’re hoping that were going to be having a full-strength Danny Granger this year to add to this team that made a lot of noise last year.”

Frank Vogel on Danny Granger, Aug 28, 2013. Source: Pacers.com.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Danny Granger
item.description:
Frank Vogel:

“It’s really exciting. Danny (Granger) is on schedule, looks really good, he’s making progress each week and we’re hoping that were going to be having a full-strength Danny Granger this yearto add to this team that made a lot of noise last year.”

Frank Vogel on Danny Granger, Aug 27, 2013. Source: Pacers.com.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Danny Granger
item.description:
“My message to Granger was that you just can't keep running up into people's faces for altercations. We're not fighting on this basketball court, so let's not act like we're going to fight. We can be physical and do all that, but certain things got to stop. Are you out here to play basketball or are you out here to be a tough guy?”

Dwyane Wade on Danny Granger, May 22, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Shane Battier on LeBron James, Danny Granger, Frank Vogel
item.description:
Frank Vogel says everybody’s talking about LeBron's defense on Danny Granger but nobody's talking Shane Battier's defense on Granger:

“We put some different looks in just to try to get (Granger) freed up from LeBron but also from Battier,'' Vogel said.”

Shane Battier on LeBron James, Danny Granger, Frank Vogel, May 15, 2012. Source: Sulia.
